SECURITY

Security controls for connected customer work.

UnifyDesk handles connections to important business systems. The product is being built with account, company and provider controls at the application layer.

Company isolation

Workspace data and access are organized around company boundaries.

Role-based access

Roles control what users can access and manage inside a company.

Two-factor authentication

TOTP-based 2FA adds another verification step for supported account flows.

Provider protection

Provider credentials and OAuth connections are handled as protected application configuration.

Session controls

Authentication uses controlled sessions with security flows around tokens and sign-out.

SECURITY PRINCIPLE

Access should follow the company and the role.

Authentication, authorization and connected-provider access are designed around explicit workspace boundaries rather than a single shared global context.
